actions.description: Verify both services recover after an explicit restart
actions.command: systemctl restart queue-api.service queue-worker.service && sleep 0.3 && curl --fail --silent --show-error http://127.0.0.1:8080/health && printf '\n' && systemctl is-active queue-api.service queue-worker.service

actions.description: Verify every persisted job has the required result and attempt count
actions.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/var/lib/job-queue/jobs.sqlite3')
rows = conn.execute('SELECT id, payload, status, result, attempts FROM jobs ORDER BY rowid').fetchall()
assert rows
for job_id, payload, status, result, attempts in rows:
    assert status == 'completed', (job_id, status)
    assert result == 'processed:' + payload, (job_id, result)
    assert attempts == 1, (job_id, attempts)
print(f'{len(rows)} jobs verified: completed with one attempt each')
PY
actions.output_excerpt: 5 jobs verified: completed with one attempt each

actions.description: Check seed behavior for reboot persistence
actions.command: exec_path=$(systemctl show -p ExecStart --value queue-seed.service | sed -n 's/.*path=\([^ ;]*\).*/\1/p'); printf 'seed exec: %s\n' "$exec_path"; if [ -n "$exec_path" ] && [ -f "$exec_path" ]; then sed -n '1,200p' "$exec_path"; fi
